items.exampleEn: How much time do you set aside for reading each day?
items.exampleZh: 你每天撥出多少時間閱讀？

items.exampleEn: Last month, a computer problem set back the opening of our online shop.
items.exampleZh: 上個月，電腦出了問題，使我們的網路商店延後開幕。

items.exampleEn: The website will shut down for an hour tonight.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站今晚會關閉一個小時。

items.exampleEn: In a room full of black suits, his red jacket really stood out.
items.exampleZh: 在滿是黑色西裝的房間裡，他的紅色外套特別顯眼。

items.exampleEn: After twenty years as leader, she decided to step down.
items.exampleZh: 當了二十年的領導人之後，她決定辭職。

items.exampleEn: She took the job on even though she was busy.
items.exampleZh: 雖然很忙，她還是接下了這份工作。

items.exampleEn: There was too much information to take in.
items.exampleZh: 資訊太多了，一時消化不了。

items.sentenceEn: Please shut your computer down before you leave.

items.audioEn: Our coach is stepping down at the end of the season, so the club is looking for someone new.
items.audioZh: 我們的教練這一季結束後就要辭職了，所以社團正在找新的人。
items.questionZh: 這個社團為什麼在找人？
options: Their coach is going to quit
The team needs more players for next season
The club wants to open a second branch

items.sentenceEn: Bright colors help a shop sign stand out.
items.sentenceZh: 鮮豔的顏色能讓店家招牌更顯眼。

items.sentenceEn: My aunt took a lost cat in.
items.sentenceZh: 我阿姨收留了一隻走失的貓。

items.stemEn: Every month, I ____ some money for my summer holiday.
items.stemZh: 我每個月都會撥出一些錢給暑假旅行用。

items.stemEn: The company is growing fast and plans to ____ fifty new workers this year.
items.stemZh: 這家公司成長很快，打算今年雇用五十名新員工。

items.passageEn: Last spring, the small library in our village was about to shut down because it had lost most of its funding. Then Mrs. Wu, a former teacher, decided to run it herself. She set two rooms aside for children and asked local families to give their old books. A problem with the roof caused a delay of one month. Still, the library opened again in September, and it now stands out as the busiest place in the village.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我們村裡的小圖書館因為失去了大部分的經費，差點要關閉。後來，曾經當過老師的吳太太決定自己來經營。她留出兩個房間給孩子用，並請當地的家庭捐出家裡的舊書。屋頂出了問題，讓工作延誤了一個月。不過，圖書館還是在九月重新開放，現在它是村裡最熱鬧的地方。

questions.questionZh: 去年春天圖書館為什麼差點關閉？
options: 村裡的孩子都不喜歡看書
吳太太決定不再管理圖書館

questions.questionZh: 吳太太替孩子做了什麼？
options: 每天下午為他們講一個故事
幫每個家庭找到便宜的舊書
留出兩個房間給他們用

items.promptZh: 這場大雨讓我們的旅行延後了一天。
referenceEn: The heavy rain set our trip back by a day.
The heavy rain set back our trip by one day.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「使延誤」（例如 set our trip back、set back our trip 等）；受詞可放在 back 的前面或後面
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 delayed our trip by a day、put off our trip、held up our trip 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 set back、has set back 等）
「延後了一天」可寫，例如 by a day、by one day 等

items.promptZh: 我這個月沒辦法再接更多工作了。
referenceEn: I can't take on any more work this month.
This month, I'm not able to take on more work.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「承擔」（例如 take on more work 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 take more work、accept more work 等）
「沒辦法」可寫，例如 can't、am not able to 等
「更多工作」可寫，例如 any more work、more work、more jobs 等
